description: Duplicate collapse reporting should group every staged row family by its database primary key before any bulk load or promotion readiness decision.
Duplicate normalized objects, object embeddings, or index records are higher-risk than shared source/entity rows and should be called out separately.
Duplicate primary keys with different row hashes should block candidate-table loading until an operator or curator resolves the conflict.
Reports should classify duplicate keys by ID source, including hash-suffixed IDs, truncation-risk IDs, shared source records, shared entities, and composite keys.
The duplicate-collapse reporter reads staged JSONL and writes summary evidence only; it must not repair rows, apply SQL, or mutate indexes.
